en: Honestly the 2018 Yamaha Femina looks way better than the 2023 version. I was told the performance isn't that different, so I went with the design I liked. They also told me the half bag colors.
ko:
야마하 페미나는 23년 버전보다 18년도가 디자인적으로 최고죵 성능도 얼마 차이 안난다하셔서 맘에드는 디자인으로 선택했습니다.
하프백 색상도 말씀해주시고

en: My skills aren't there yet, so I haven't used every club. But the value is great. I'm going to work on my game and take the full set out once the weather warms up.
ko:
실력이 부족해서 아직 모든 채를 사용하지 않았지만
가성비하나는 짱인듯 합니다
언능 실력키워서 날씨 따스해지면 풀세트 들고
나갈려고요

en: Pleasantly surprised. The iron covers are shipping separately, they're light and nice. The bag is pretty too. Good overall. I'll wait for the iron covers to arrive.
ko: 깜놀입니다 아이언커버는 따로 가볍고 좋아요 가방도 이뿌구요 좋습니다 아이언커버 올거니까 기다릴께요

en: I'm a beginner golfer at 1 month in, so I can't really speak to how it feels, but I've only used rental clubs, and compared to those this feels a bit lighter and nicer. I picked it because I totally fell for the design and colors. Bummer that there were no iron covers, and the glove they sent was way too small. I took it as a little cheer for hitting it farther, which was a thoughtful touch, though I'm not sure what it's meant for. Anyway, I'm happy with the product overall.
ko:
골린이 1개월차라 사용감에 대한건 잘 모르겠습니다만 클럽 대여채만 써봐서 그것 대비 좀 가볍고 좋은 것 같아요. 디자인 색감에 완전 반해서 골랐네요. 아이언커버는 없어 아쉽고, 주신 장갑이 너무 작은게 와서 좀 아쉽네요. 비거리 잘 나오라는 응원인것 같아 센스있다 생각했습니다. 용도는 뭔지 모르겠지만요.
암튼 전반적으로 상품 만족합니다.

en: Awesome. My old clubs were heavy, so I was looking for lighter ones and picked this. I'm happy with the set makeup, the design and the service. I'll use them for a month and see.
ko: 짱입니다. 기존클럽이 무거워가벼운채 고르다 선택했어요. 구성. 디자인. 서비스 모두 만족스럽습니다. 한달 사용해보고 사용

en: After waiting so long, I do like the design. But I understand iron covers were supposed to come with it, and they didn't. Please check on this.
ko:
오래기다렸던만큼 디자인은 맘에듭니다
근데 아이언커버를 주는걸로 아는데 아이언커버가 안왔습니다. 확인부탁드립니다

en: I waited a long time, but with clubs this hard to find these days, I'm just glad I got them. The iron covers are pink, which is a bit much. I bought the bag in white, so it's not bad.
ko:
오래 기다렸지만 요즘같은 클럽 품귀 시절에 받은것이 다행이라고 생각합니다.
아이언 커버가 핑크라 좀.
가방을 화이트로 구입해서
나쁘진 않아요.

en: The packaging was neat and pretty. I'm not strong, so with heavy clubs my best distance was 120. I searched a lot, and since people say beginners should go for what looks good and what they like, I picked the sky blue Yamaha Femina. The driver is light, so it's easy to carry around. My distance definitely went up. I've heard from others that it's whippy, but I was looking for that feel on purpose, so if you want light clubs, this is perfect!
ko:
포장도 꼼꼼히 예쁘게왓어요.
근력이부족해서 무거운채로치니까 비거리가120이최고치더라고요. 검색많이해보고 초보는 예쁘고맘에드는거라는 말에 야마하 페미나 하늘색을찾앗네요.
우선 드라이버 가벼워서 들기가편하네요
비거리 확실히 늘엇네요. 주위에서들어보고 낭창거린다는데 전 일부러 그런느낌을찾은거라 가벼운채원하시면 딱입니당!
